name: postey
description: Postey hub: MCP/CLI routing, accounts, platform truth, the post lifecycle and the shared craft layer, plus the local-file and large-upload paths the MCP server cannot reach. Content flows ship as optional packs that require this one (postey-ideas, postey-video, postey-voice, postey-engagement, postey-analytics, postey-ops, postey-teams). Load references on demand.
note: rawBase pins the immutable release tag skills/postey/v<version>. Push that tag when releasing (see CLAUDE.md) or fetches 404. The bootstrap prompt fetches this manifest from main; everything else is fetched from the pinned tag so a later push to main cannot rewrite already-installed playbooks.
